requirements.rule: LATER UNSIGNED TRANCHES: the May 2026 and later minima of the renewal of 13 June 2025 (CNEL K511, deposits 234754 and 234752) were not signed by ANIP and are excluded. The signed July 2025 fifth tranche of the 2021 renewal (CNEL 139292 p. 34) is applied; no subsequent ANIP minimum or actual IPCA adjustment has been verified.
requirements.remediation: Source an ANIP-signed later minimum or verified IPCA adjustment before adding subsequent tranches.

requirements.rule: The engine computes the rate of the separate taxation of arrears from PriorYearTaxFacts.net_income_biennio (art. 21 cc. 1, 3 TUIR) and reduces the tax by ArrearsEvent.unused_deductions, the deductions of artt. 12 and 13 cc. 1-2 the worker did not use in the years the arrears refer to (art. 21 c. 4). An arrears event that does not state them, among which the una tantum the engine pays itself, is taxed without the reduction, so the tax may be overstated.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.variable_pay.arrears.handlers._handle_arrears; art. 21 TUIR (Normattiva, text in force from 31-12-2024 to 31-12-2026, page sha256 9638f2c5aec6e3615193a672b6d07c3cd31083640b1c890b73022aa9951745f1)
requirements.remediation: State ArrearsEvent.unused_deductions from the worker's declaration of the deductions used each year; for the una tantum, carry it into the events the engine generates.

requirements.rule: APPRENTICESHIP (Allegato 8 of the 2021 compiled CCNL, reproducing the 19 July 2012 agreement): the tracks use the printed maximum duration. For destinations V-VII a relevant diploma shortens the term by 6 months and a relevant degree by 12 months; absence over 30 days extends the term by the absence duration. Individual term adjustments are not represented by the maximum-term tracks.
requirements.remediation: Supply the individually agreed term and qualification or absence details before applying a shortened or extended progression; the tracks encode only the printed maximum terms.

requirements.rule: VARIABLE ALLOWANCES (CNEL 105782 arts. 22 and 24): the 3% tabellare cash-handling allowance is modeled for a caller-stated role normally handling money with liability for errors. Hardship requires qualifying daily cleaning events and the correct daily tabellare base; collection requires qualifying collections above EUR 4.65 and a 5% retribuzione base; the hourly cleaning allowances require actual duty hours and non-cumulation where applicable. Personal EDAR retained under art. 22 requires an individual amount and absorption at the next qualifying seniority increment. No unsupported amounts or event counts are inferred.
requirements.remediation: Route qualifying hardship days, collection events and hourly duty hours to their distinct bases; track individual EDAR and its absorption at the next qualifying increment. The cash-handling role supplement is modeled.

requirements.rule: PART-TIME SUPPLEMENTS (CNEL 139292 art. 33): supplementary hours and elastic clauses have distinct rates and eligibility. OT_SUPPLEMENTARE covers additional hours at ordinary global hourly pay plus 28% of tabellare and contingenza. The engine does not defer the 28% to the following month or include its incidence in indirect and deferred pay including TFR; it does not route the distinct elastic-clause hours, enforce part-time eligibility or the full-time ceiling.
requirements.remediation: Route elastic clauses separately (10% on global pay for shifted hours, plus 1.5% for additional hours); enforce part-time eligibility and the full-time ceiling, next-month settlement and incidence on deferred pay including TFR.

requirements.rule: COMPLEMENTARY PENSION (CNEL 105782 art. 54, pp. 69-70): The frozen 1 January 2001 tabellare and contingenza bases, 1% employer and member shares and twelve monthly payments are modelled for enrolled workers. Fund eligibility still depends on the employer association (Previambiente for FISE, Fondapi for CONFAPI, Cooperlavoro for cooperatives, with a choice for non-affiliated employers); fixed-term membership requires six months of work within the calendar year. These eligibility facts are not established by the enrolment alone. ASIM and ONBSI are addressed by the separate health_and_bilateral_funds limitation.
requirements.remediation: Verify the employer association and accumulated calendar-year fixed-term work before accepting the caller-selected fund and enrolment. No eligibility is inferred from the level or the fund code.

requirements.rule: SENIORITY (CNEL 105782 art. 22, pp. 41-42, 90): Category-specific amounts now pay operai at levels 1-6 after four years (including levels 5 and 6), with at most one quota; levels 5-7 and Q pay impiegati up to eight biennial scatti. The impiegati scatti of levels 2-4 come from the appendix of the text signed on 8 June 2021 (PDF p. 85, https://www.filcams.cgil.it/GetMedia.aspx?id=7bef7b20933046cdac04bba6babe5cc5&s=0, sha256 ca01d1213d006e18f2955501a333393f548b4398fac85ff37837510ae664593f); its 1 July 2025 column is marked 'PROVVISORIO AI SENSI DELL'ART.73'. Without an EarnedIncrements worker fact, matured scatti are still repriced at the run date, including after promotion; the 50% ceiling of tabellare plus EUR 279.60 is not enforced. The worker must supply recognised sector service across contract changes and the correct category at mixed levels.
requirements.remediation: Supply earned amounts and recognised sector service from worker records, and implement automatic maturation-date pricing and the 50% ceiling; confirm the provisional July 2025 column.

requirements.rule: SICKNESS (CNEL 139292 art. 51, pp. 22-24): category routing, the 100% net-global-pay operai band through day 180, the 50% band through day 270, the impiegati 100% first five months and 50% next seven months, and the rolling 36-month comporto are represented. Remaining: the operai 50% band is of gross global pay, while the model applies net_basis to the whole rule; impiegati pay is stipendio plus contingenza, while the engine uses global pay. The operai first working day and the impiegati non-probation and serious-fault conditions are not represented. The clause does not state a daily gross/net conversion or an amount for the excluded pay components.
requirements.remediation: Apply gross rather than net basis to operai days 181-270, restrict impiegati pay to stipendio plus contingenza, and respect the first-working-day and eligibility conditions; use the worker's actual category at mixed-category levels.

requirements.rule: OVERTIME AND NIGHT WORK (CNEL 105782 art. 38, p. 57): ordinary overtime hours use global pay, whereas percentage supplements use base pay (tabellare and contingenza). Holiday work attracts 50%; ordinary night work attracts 20% in rotating shifts or 30% otherwise. The four overtime bands, the ordinary holiday band and the two night bands use the printed rates, with a separate tabellare-plus-contingenza premium base. The engine cannot automatically enforce the non-cumulation of simultaneous holiday and night premiums or the incidence of continuous night supplements on deferred pay.
requirements.remediation: Do not stack simultaneous holiday and night premiums; account for continuous night premiums in deferred pay where applicable.

requirements.rule: A parental leave by the hour takes half the average daily hours a day and counts two such days as one day of leave, the general criterion of art. 32 c. 1-ter D.Lgs. 151/2001 (INPS circ. 152/2015 par. 2.2); a collective agreement, also of the company, that sets other hours to a day of leave or other rules of cumulation prevails, and the bundle holds none.
requirements.remediation: Source the collective rules on the leave by the hour of the CCNL (hours of a day of leave, cumulation) and apply them, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: L. 260/1949 art. 5 pays the workers with a fixed salary a further daily quota only for the civil holidays (25 April, 1 May, 2 June) falling on a Sunday; the other holidays of art. 2 (1 January, 6 January, Easter Monday, 15 August, 4 October, 1 November, 8 December, 25 and 26 December) give it only by CCNL clause, and the payment of 4 November is a CCNL institute. A run of a month with such a holiday on a Sunday, in a CCNL whose clause is not sourced (work_rules.sunday_holidays), pays the statutory holidays only; a public employment is paid none, its treatment not being sourced.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.sunday_holiday.services.sunday_holiday; L. 260/1949 artt. 2 and 5 (Normattiva, art. 2 page sha256 42631c3dd629fe3a1c5e10efc7e3b7b86bb5a2b5325024aa4105eaadfcb49828, art. 5 page sha256 dbd670c663744af9); L. 54/1977 art. 1 (page sha256 cde3b9773f4411d28334a85bebdf9358fc4c161d745772df70f38bc79f48d09e)
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on the holidays falling on a Sunday and record it as work_rules.sunday_holidays.

requirements.rule: The una tantum of a renewal is paid from the CCNL data with readings no text read settles in full: a month of service in the covered period counts with the days of the una tantum (15 when the text is silent), over the months of the period; the absences of a month do not reduce it, though a text may pay the months 'di effettiva prestazione'; a part time is paid in proportion to its hours; a run without the employment period is paid none; the share of the covered months of earlier years is taxed apart as arrears.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.una_tantum.rules.una_tantum_events; CCNL agenti immobiliari FIAIP 19 May 2025 art. 163 (pp. 97-98, sha256 560d16410d3e41dc0bfb00bfe2a40ef65f2cd900234aeaee92018ed9fa21ead5)
requirements.remediation: Source the counting of the months, the part time and the taxation of each una tantum from its agreement, then resolve this limitation.
